_comment: Provider template — FILENAME=ROUTE (deepseek: the credential+endpoint channel; token var derives from it). `_family` = MODEL LINEAGE (deepseek) — the same/different-family judgment unit (model-routing.md). `model` = the pinned per-generation id, never part of the filename. Route: the official DeepSeek API (api.deepseek.com) — one route of the deepseek family. EXAMPLE of a user-authored provider extension: copy this file to profiles/<name>.json, set routing + <UPPERCASE-NAME>_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (convention; override via `_token_env`); no code change. See model-routing.md. ADR #40.
